_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround iti {width}x{height} grid.
Kayatka a player {player_id}. Nabalo a pagliwliwa: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' wenno w/s/a/d.
Objetibo: agbiag iti amin. Dagiti trails ket mapatay; dagiti wall hits ket mapatay; head-on crashes ket mapatay kadakayo dua.

board.after_moves: Board kalpasan ti agpapada a panagdaliasat: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Ti agay-ayam {player_id} ket natay gapu iti saan a maitutop nga iyaakar.

outcome.survived_win: Nagbiag ti agay-ayam {player_id}; nagdisso dagiti dadduma.
outcome.all_crashed: Agpapada a nagcrash amin nga agay-ayam.
outcome.outlived: Ti Player ti nakalasat kadagiti amin a dadduma.
outcome.turn_limit: Naabot ti limitasion iti panagbueltana - mangabak daydiay nakalasat a nangatngato.
